caption: The rope on a flagpole is pulled steadily, and the flag rises up the pole as the rope runs through the pulley at the top.

sa.check: A flag hangs on a flagpole with a rope.
The flag rises up the pole.
The pulley at the top of the pole is visible.
The pull is steady rather than in jerks.

pc.expect: The rope stays taut on the pulled side and does not stretch or go slack while lifting.
pc.fail: The pulled side hangs slack while the flag rises; or the rope stretches; or it bunches.

pc.expect: The flag moves only as fast as rope is pulled in and stops when the pulling stops.
pc.fail: The flag rises with no pull; or keeps rising after the pull stops; or the rope is pulled and the flag stays put.

pc.expect: The flag hangs or flutters from its clips, and the rope runs straight down from the pulley.
pc.fail: The flag rises above the pulley; or the rope rises away from the pole; or the flag floats up ahead of the rope.

pc.expect: One side of the rope goes up as the other comes down.
pc.fail: Both sides go up; or the rope does not move while the flag rises; or the flag goes down as the rope is pulled.

pc.expect: One flag, one rope and one pole keep their number.
pc.fail: The flag vanishes or a second appears; or the rope passes through the pole; or the flag turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The flag's colours, the pole and the sky stay the same.
pc.fail: The flag changes colours; or the pole changes; or the background rearranges.
